name: Andrew Gordon

quote: Very happy with the results on my Outlander. They were able to take it in on short notice on a Sunday, which was a huge help. Ananth at Imperium Detailing was honest and upfront about the work they were doing, and the exterior detail came up beautifully.

name: mills
quote: Ananth was a pleasure to deal with from the beginning, great communication and an even better finished product. So great company and great service and my car is so shiny almost like new! Highly recommend Imperium detailing and have already placed to have my other car done asap.

name: Daniel Vidiceski
quote: the boys were great, really friendly and did an excellent job and service on the detail and clean for my car.

name: Bradley

name: Phillip Parker
quote: Fantastic work. Prompt, polite and a fantastic result on both my BMW and my Wife's New Kia. Highly recommend. 5 year ceramic coating on both cars.

name: SoyBean Sensei

name: Robyn Croker
quote: The Ute has come up beautifully. Interior feels like a new car again the exterior is shining. Lovely young blokes having a go and doing a good job of it. Thanks boys.

name: Adrian Schimizzi

name: Angus Whitby

name: Sonal Singh
